description: Counter staff create the ticket, record the device and fault, capture consent, and quote the repair
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Intake is the front door for about 200 devices a day (about $78K revenue per business day); without tickets devices cannot be tracked, which risks mix-ups and lost customer property
manual_workaround: Pre-numbered paper intake forms with carbon copies; device bags labeled with the paper ticket number; enter into SYS-01 when restored
dependent_third_parties: Ticketing and POS vendor; internet service providers
dependent_people_or_facilities: Customer service advisors; all 4 stores and the Depot counter

description: Technicians diagnose, order or pull parts, repair, test, and update the ticket
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Same-day repairs (screens, batteries) are about 60% of volume; parts pairing and calibration for Manufacturer A devices need its online tools; customers expect promised turnaround
manual_workaround: Paper job cards; repairs that need no manufacturer tool continue; parts pulled from the printed stock list
dependent_third_parties: Manufacturer A and B tools; parts suppliers

description: Counter staff take payment on P2PE terminals, verify identity, and release the device
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: No payment means no revenue and devices pile up; releasing a device to the wrong person discloses the customer's data
manual_workaround: P2PE terminals can run standalone for card payments; printed release checklist with photo ID check; hand invoices

description: Submit warranty repairs, parts returns, and reimbursement claims in the manufacturer portals
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 25% of revenue comes as manufacturer reimbursements; claims have submission windows set in the program agreements; missed windows lose reimbursement
manual_workaround: Record claims on a spreadsheet and submit when the portal returns

description: Image failing drives and devices, recover files, deliver data to the customer, move data between devices
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Premium service with fixed quotes; some failing media can be read only once, so losing an image can mean the customer's data is gone for good; recovered data is highly personal, so any loss or exposure is a breach risk
manual_workaround: Pause new cases; keep drives sealed in the lab; tell customers of delays

description: Receive shipped devices, open tickets, take phone payments, and ship repaired devices back
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 9% of tickets; customers are out of state and rely on tracking; shipping labels come from the courier portal
manual_workaround: Log parcels on paper; hold returns until labels can be printed

description: Status texts and emails from SYS-01, the chatbot, phones, and the customer status portal
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers call when updates stop; phone volume would swamp the counters
manual_workaround: Phone script; staff call customers whose devices are ready; chatbot turned off with a banner
dependent_third_parties: Ticketing and POS vendor; chatbot vendor; phone carrier

description: Scheduled and on-site repairs for 140 business accounts, monthly invoices, ACH collection
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Contracts promise turnaround times and data handling terms; invoices are monthly, so a short outage does not affect cash
manual_workaround: Track work on paper; invoice late

description: Accept devices for recycling, wipe or destroy storage, hand lots to the certified recycler
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: No revenue impact; devices can wait in locked bins; the risk is data exposure, not downtime
manual_workaround: Stop accepting drop-offs; keep bins locked

description: Time capture, payroll, onboarding, terminations, background checks
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs biweekly; a missed payroll has legal and retention impact
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll through the payroll provider
dependent_third_parties: Payroll and HR SaaS; background check vendor
